title: Optimal Transport driven CycleGAN for Unsupervised Learning in Inverse Problems
tldr_zh: 从 Kantorovich 对偶推导 OT-cycleGAN，前向算子已知时砍掉一半生成器，在加速 MRI、SMLM、低剂量 CT 验证
tldr_en: Derives OT-cycleGAN from Kantorovich duality; known forward operator halves the architecture; validated on accelerated MRI, SMLM, low-dose CT

key_numbers.number: 3500 slices, 3000 train / 500 test, acceleration factor 4, ACS 4%
discriminator updated 5 times per generator update, 100 epochs, lr=0.0001
